title: Schedule Management
description: Configure your working hours and register your leave days.

offDays.title: Register Off Day
offDays.description: Select a date on the calendar to register an off day. The system will warn you if any appointments are affected.

cancelModal.title: Cancel Leave Request
cancelModal.description: Are you sure you want to cancel this leave request? Your work schedule for this day will be restored to normal.

affectedModal.title: Affected Appointments
affectedModal.description: Off day on {date} will be registered. There are {count} appointments that will be affected:
affectedModal.footerNote: Confirming will AUTOMATICALLY CANCEL the appointments above. Please contact patients afterward to reschedule.
